Iron ore crash confirmed by macrobusiness, posing direct downside risk to BHP, RIO, FMG revenue
ASX treads water as Fed meeting looms; 10-year US treasury yield rises, tightening global liquidity
AI sector volatility: Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs issue doomsday warnings, spooking global tech; Trump pushes back
ANZ completes 3,500 job cuts; major private hospital operator faces division after financial collapse
Fuel price blowout pressures Albanese government for second excise cut, adding inflationary headwinds
Australian energy inflection point approaching; housing market shows no spring bounce, prices under pressure
Small-cap mining activity: Critica 19Mt tin-tungsten (Tas), Forrestania 2Mt WA gold, Sarytogan 97.7% graphite yield

sectors.trend: Iron ore crash confirmed; however, small-cap discoveries (Critica tin-tungsten, Forrestania gold, Sarytogan graphite, PLC Resources gold) provide selective upside. Steelworks job cuts signal weak downstream demand.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from iron ore decline. Small-cap miners (CRA.AX, FGT.AX) offer speculative upside. Steel sector (BLT.AX) under pressure.

sectors.trend: Oil spike from Saudi pipeline shutdown and Houthi Red Sea threats lifts upstream; fuel price blowout pressures downstream and consumers. Australia nears energy inflection point.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, XAR.AX benefit from higher oil. BEX.AX, QAN.AX face margin compression from fuel costs. Renewable/energy transition names gain policy tailwind.

sectors.trend: ANZ executes 3,500 job cuts; mortgage rate sales (Chase) signal competitive pressure. Rising 10-year yields support NIMs but cap rate risk. Housing market softens.
sectors.implications: ANZ.AX restructuring may boost near-term EPS but signals weak loan growth. CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher yields. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by rising rates and weak housing.

sectors.trend: Major private hospital operator faces division after financial collapse; SA Health data breach noted. Sector consolidation underway.
sectors.implications: Private hospital operators (IAG.AX, ADF.AX) face reputational and competitive risk. CSL.AX, SGH.AX remain defensive anchors. Consolidation may create M&A opportunities.

sectors.trend: Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs issue AI slowdown warnings; global tech sells off. Trump counters with 'whoever wins with AI wins.' Limited direct ASX exposure but sentiment spillover.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) face sentiment drag. Global AI capex slowdown could reduce demand for Australian data centre and infrastructure plays.

sectors.trend: Fuel price blowout squeezes household budgets; caravan manufacturer shuts; coffeehouse Chapter 11 filings; alcohol consumption declining. Housing affordability stress.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX, CCL.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Defensive consumer staples preferred. REITs and home loan brokers under pressure.

key_themes: Commodity bifurcation: oil up, iron ore down – mixed for ASX 200
Geopolitical risk premium: Red Sea, Saudi pipeline, Iran tensions
AI narrative shift from euphoria to caution
Housing market cooling with no spring bounce
Migration policy debate impacting labour supply and productivity

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; diversify into gold (NVS.AX, GRY.AX) and critical minerals
Hedge fuel-cost exposure; favour upstream energy (WDS.AX, XAR.AX); monitor RBA response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI sector correction / global tech selloff
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit ASX tech exposure; monitor global Nasdaq spillover; favour cash-generative large caps
Underweight REITs and home-loan brokers; monitor NAB.AX, CBA.AX loan loss provisions
Avoid distressed hospital operators; favour CSL.AX, SGH.AX as defensive healthcare
Shorten duration in fixed income; favour floating-rate and short-dated bonds; monitor RBA

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight upstream energy on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Saudi pipeline shutdown and Houthi escalation support oil prices; Australian upstream producers benefit directly

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap mining exposure on critical minerals
opportunities.rationale: Critica tin-tungsten, Forrestania gold, Sarytogan graphite signal active exploration pipeline; battery-grade graphite aligns with energy transition
Private hospital collapse creates consolidation opportunity; CSL and SGH offer stable cash flows amid sector stress

defensive_moves.rationale: Confirmed iron ore crash and steelworks job cuts signal structural demand weakness; BHP, RIO, FMG face earnings downgrades
No spring bounce, falling prices, rising yields create triple headwind for property sector

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge fuel-cost inflation risk in consumer portfolio
defensive_moves.rationale: Fuel blowout pressures WES, WOW margins; second excise cut unlikely before Fed meeting

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower. Oil spike supports energy but iron ore crash and AI selloff offset gains. Fed meeting and RBA commentary are key near-term catalysts. Fuel inflation may force RBA to hold or signal hawkish bias. Expect volatility around ^AXJO 8,200–8,500 range.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift in commodity mix (oil up, iron ore down) favours energy and critical minerals over traditional iron ore majors. Housing correction and migration policy reform may slow GDP but support financial stability. Energy transition inflection creates multi-year tailwind for renewables and battery minerals. Superannuation reform debate could reshape long-term capital flows.

Oil price sustainability post-Saudi pipeline repair
Australian energy policy / inflection point legislation
Housing auction data and credit conditions

RBA cash rate and inflation forecast
Red Sea shipping disruption / freight rates
